query: What information must an employee provide when notifying the company of their intention to take paternity leave?
response:
According to the provided documents, when notifying the company of their intention to take paternity leave, an employee must provide the following information:

1. The week the baby is due (Document id: '9eb60495-e66d-4c2b-bb8b-66e8f7b0dc17', section 6.1.1)
2. Whether they wish to take one or two weeks leave (Document id: '9eb60495-e66d-4c2b-bb8b-66e8f7b0dc17', section 6.1.2)
3. When they want their leave to start (Document id: '9eb60495-e66d-4c2b-bb8b-66e8f7b0dc17', section 6.1.3)

Additionally, the employee must inform the company of their intention to take paternity leave by the end of the 15th week before the baby is expected, unless this is not reasonably practical (Document id: '9eb60495-e66d-4c2b-bb8b-66e8f7b0dc17', section 6.1).
